北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京今天晴朗，体感 4℃ 左右，早晚温差大，注意保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny with a perceived temperature of 4℃. Mind the temperature changes!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阳光正好，体感 5℃。白天舒适，早晚记得加衣哟。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny and feels like 5℃. Stay warm, especially in the morning and evening.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阳光明媚，体感 4℃。风力不大，但体感仍凉，多穿点哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny, feels like 4℃. It's chilly, so layer up!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光灿烂，体感 13℃。风力 3级，风儿有些凉，别着凉啦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny, feels like 13℃. A bit windy, so keep warm.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳天气晴好，体感 16℃。微风舒适，但也别掉以轻心哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and feels like 16℃. Enjoy the breeze, but stay mindful of the temperature.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阳光明媚，体感 4℃。虽有阳光，仍需注意防寒保暖哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny and feels like 4℃. Despite the sun, remember to keep warm.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阳光正好，体感 3℃。气温偏低，外出记得多穿点。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny, but feels like 3℃. Dress warmly if you're going out!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 3℃。湿度 100%，湿冷加倍，注意防潮保暖。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and feels like 3℃. High humidity makes it feel colder, so bundle up!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 4℃。湿度 60%，湿冷感明显，要穿暖和哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feels like 4℃. It's damp and chilly, so dress warmly.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 0℃。湿冷刺骨，出门务必多穿，防寒保暖！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and feels like 0℃. It's bitterly cold and damp, so bundle up!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 7℃。湿度较高，出门记得带伞，注意保暖。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels like 7℃. High humidity, bring an umbrella and stay warm.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，体感 -17℃！严寒来袭，务必全副武装，注意防冻！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy and feels like -17℃! It's freezing, so dress very warmly and prevent frostbite.
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -17℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，体感 -9℃。气温很低，出门一定要穿厚实点哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny, but feels like -9℃. It's very cold, so bundle up when you go out!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，体感 4℃。风力 5级，风大体感冷，注意防风保暖。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and feels like 4℃. Strong winds make it feel colder, so keep warm.
昆明.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阳光明媚，体感 9℃。风力 3级，海边风大，注意防风。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny, feels like 9℃. With 3-grade wind, it's breezy by the sea, keep warm.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴朗，体感 2℃。风力不大，但仍需注意添衣保暖哦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny, feels like 2℃. It's still chilly, so remember to wear layers.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴天，体感 -1℃。温度较低，出门记得戴好帽子手套。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny, but feels like -1℃. It's cold, so remember your hat and gloves.
